abstract: We examine the impact of encouragement emails sent to high-performing students in a principles of microeconomics course at a large state university, aimed at motivating them to take additional economics courses and consider an economics major or minor. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find some evidence of an increase in the likelihood of enrolling in intermediate microeconomics, especially for first-generation college students and underrepresented minorities, but limited effects on major switching or declaring an economics minor. Our findings suggest sustained interventions may be necessary to produce lasting effects.
title: The economics of encouragement: Can a simple email shape major choice?
title_zh: 鼓励的经济学：一封简单的电子邮件能否影响专业选择？

abstract: How can we assess the diversity of a group of decision makers? Identifying decision makers with their preferences, we address this question by applying the multi-attribute approach developed by Nehring and Puppe (2002) to sets of preferences. Specifically, we provide a repertoire of alternative models to measure the diversity of sets of preferences. The proposed models are purely ordinal and are characterized in terms of the different properties that a preference order need to satisfy in order to contribute to the diversity of a given set of preference orderings.
abstract_zh: 如何评估一组决策者的多样性？通过将决策者与其偏好相对应，我们运用Nehring和Puppe（2002）发展的多属性方法来解决这一问题，并将其应用于偏好集合。具体而言，我们提供了一系列替代模型来衡量偏好集合的多样性。所提出的模型纯属序数性质，并通过偏好序需满足的不同属性来刻画，这些属性决定了偏好序对给定偏好序集合多样性的贡献。
title: Preference diversity

abstract: In this study, we examine whether and how the environmental sensitivity of major customers influences their suppliers’ green innovation. Drawing on the spillover effect perspective, we argue that major customers located in heavily polluting industries face heightened stakeholder scrutiny, which can spill over to their suppliers and motivate the suppliers to enhance green innovation. Using as a sample of Chinese listed firms from 2008 to 2021 and adopting the Tobit regression analysis, we find a positive effect of heavily polluting customers on suppliers’ green innovation. Moreover, the geographical proximity and interlocking directors between the customers and suppliers tend to amplify, while suppliers’ ISO 14,001 certification tends to mitigate, the above effect. Mechanism analysis indicates that increased media attention towards suppliers’ environmental practices serves as a channel through which spillover occurs. Our study contributes to the literature by clarifying how major customers influence supplier green innovation and enriching the understanding of spillover effects in supply chains. KEYWORDS: Major customers green innovation customer-supplier relationship spillover effect JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q55 M10 M14
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨主要客户的环境敏感性是否及如何影响其供应商的绿色创新。基于溢出效应视角，我们提出，位于重污染行业的主要客户面临更严格的外部利益相关者审查，这种审查压力会沿供应链传导至供应商，进而激励供应商提升绿色创新水平。以2008至2021年中国上市公司为样本，采用Tobit回归分析，我们发现重污染客户对供应商绿色创新具有正向促进作用。此外，客户与供应商之间的地理邻近性与连锁董事关系会强化该效应，而供应商的ISO 14001认证则会弱化该效应。机制分析表明，媒体对供应商环境实践关注度的提升是溢出效应发生的重要传导渠道。本研究通过阐明主要客户影响供应商绿色创新的作用机制，丰富了供应链溢出效应的理论认知。关键词：主要客户；绿色创新；客户-供应商关系；溢出效应 JEL分类：Q55 M10 M14
